title: The sync gate runs the tests of the code a push changes
goal: The fast tests.py of kbgit.py sync's gate also runs the slow tests that cover the files the pushed range changes (for example TestCloudInGit when _tools/kbgit.py or _tools/querylog.py changed), so a push that breaks them is refused locally instead of leaving the full suite red on main; a test plants a change that breaks a slow test and shows the gate fails (SP-xourq2gj retrospective: BG-7kug25eh left main red until a review story ran the full tests.py)
notes: Merged at planning 2026-10-01 from ST-4nd3ua4q (dropped): a change to kbgit.py sync makes sync's own gate run the tests that exercise it, TestCloudInGit included, so a regression like BG-7kug25eh (lane routing broke the cloud-session distill, caught only by a later full run in SP-v5xagbyv) cannot pass the gate. Cause found at planning: testmap already selects test_ql_deliver.py for kbgit.py, but the gate's KB_TESTS_FAST=1 leaves out every git-marked test.
